name: ecommerce-payment-operations-filament
description: Optional Filament administration for the Payment Operations domain module: what a payment's ledger folds to, the ledger itself, and the three movements of money the domain publishes. There is no status field because there is no status column, no form over a payment and no edit page — a correction is a new row. No instrument and no signing secret reaches any surface.
features: State shown as a fold over the ledger, never as a stored column
No status field, no form, no create page, no edit page, no delete
Take the money, release the reservation, give the money back
Each movement gated on tenancy and on the ledger's own answer
Idempotency keys derived from the ledger, never minted per press
A permanent conflict and a transient claim told apart by class
Refusals surfaced verbatim, never clamped
The reconciliation queue as a filter and a badge
Impossible ledgers explained and never corrected automatically
The mixed-currency refusal stated in words rather than left blank
Provider callbacks as a reconciliation inbox
Unowned callbacks kept out, and said so on the page
No callback body and no digest on any surface
No instrument, no provider token and no signing secret anywhere
Only a public reference is searchable
Integer minor units, formatted by the domain's own string arithmetic
Every unpublished ability refused by name
Read-only relation manager over an append-only table
Team scoping
Payments bound by public reference, never by id
